content_sections.heading: Bareilly Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The Bareilly Anganwadi Sahayika Vacancy 2026 totals 171 posts, distributed across 16 Child Development Projects (Bal Vikas Pariyojnas) in Bareilly district, with category-wise reservation as shown below. The number of vacant posts may increase or decrease as per the notification. The complete Gram Sabha/ward-wise and Anganwadi Centre-wise breakup of these posts, along with reservation and eligibility details, is displayed at the notice boards of the Collectorate, Vikas Bhawan, Tehsil and Block Development Office premises, and is also uploaded on the departmental website, upanganwadibharti.in.

content_sections.heading: Bareilly Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Bareilly Anganwadi Sahayika Eligibility for these posts is based on gender, qualification, age, residency and a defined priority order among applicants, as set out below. Only female candidates are eligible to apply for the advertised posts. Minimum educational qualification: Intermediate (12th) or its equivalent. Maximum educational qualification: Postgraduate. The candidate must be a permanent resident of the ward/Gram Sabha of the vacant post. If no eligible candidate of the required category is available in that Gram Sabha, a permanent resident of the concerned Nyay Panchayat is required instead. For posts in urban areas, the ward number/name of the concerned ward must be mentioned in the online residence certificate submitted with the application. Where more than one eligible candidate applies for a post, selection follows this order of priority, as specified in the notification: Widowed woman of a family living below the poverty line (BPL), resident of that Gram Sabha/ward. Legally divorced or abandoned (parityakta) woman of a family living below the poverty line, resident of that Gram Sabha/ward. If no widowed/divorced/abandoned candidate is available, women of families living below the poverty line of that Gram Sabha/ward. If no candidate is found under the above priority order, the following order applies: Widowed woman of a family living above the poverty line, resident of that Gram Sabha/ward. Legally divorced or abandoned woman of a family living above the poverty line, resident of that Gram Sabha/ward. Women of families living above the poverty line of that Gram Sabha/ward. For a widow candidate, the death certificate issued by the Gram Panchayat Officer/concerned Nagar Nikay along with a certified copy of the family register (Parivar Panjika) will be considered valid. For a divorced or abandoned candidate, a valid legal order issued by a competent court will be considered valid.

content_sections.heading: Bareilly Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: The Bareilly Anganwadi Sahayika Selection Process does not involve a written examination or interview. Selection is made from among eligible resident candidates as per the priority order described in the Eligibility section above (widow, legally divorced/abandoned, or below/above poverty line status), verified using supporting documents such as death certificates, court orders, income certificates and residence/caste certificates. The notification states that if any dispute arises regarding vacancies, the decision taken by the selection committee will be final. The number of vacant posts may increase or decrease, and the authority to recruit, not recruit, or cancel recruitment for the vacant posts rests with the selection committee.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Bareilly Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Bareilly Anganwadi Sahayika Apply Online is done entirely through the departmental website; no offline or postal applications are accepted. Visit the official departmental website: http://upanganwadibharti.in . Fill in the online application form carefully and correctly, in the format available on the website. Upload self-attested, clear and legible copies of the documents mentioned in the online application form. Submit the application online before the last date. The last date for submitting the online application is 29 September 2026. No application or documents submitted offline or by post will be considered valid. If any error is found in the application, or if any facts, figures or educational documents are found to be incorrect or fabricated at the time of scrutiny, the candidature will be rejected.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for Bareilly Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Based on the eligibility and selection-priority criteria described in the notification, candidates should keep the following documents ready for upload (as applicable to their category): High School marksheet/certificate (for date of birth proof) Educational qualification certificates (Intermediate or equivalent, up to postgraduate as applicable) Residence certificate (online, digitally signed, issued by Tehsil) showing ward number/name for urban applicants Caste certificate (online, digitally signed, issued by Tehsil), if applicable Income (BPL/above-BPL) certificate issued by the competent authority, not more than 3 years old from the notification date Death certificate issued by the Gram Panchayat Officer/concerned Nagar Nikay and certified copy of the family register (Parivar Panjika), for widow candidates Valid legal order issued by a competent court, for divorced/abandoned candidates

faq.question: Q1. What is Bareilly Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a direct recruitment drive by the Office of the District Programme Officer, Child Development, Bareilly, to fill 171 vacant, honorarium-based Anganwadi Sahayika (Anganwadi Helper) posts across 16 Child Development Projects in Bareilly district.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Bareilly Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 171 total vacancies: 44 for SC/ST, 51 for OBC, and 76 for General/Unreserved category, distributed across 16 projects.

faq.question: Q3. Who can apply for Bareilly Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Only female candidates who are permanent residents of the concerned ward/Gram Sabha (or the respective Nyay Panchayat, if no eligible candidate is available in the Gram Sabha) can apply, subject to the qualification, age and selection-priority criteria.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for Bareilly Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification is Intermediate (12th) or its equivalent, and the maximum qualification is Postgraduate.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for Bareilly Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum age is 35 years, calculated as on the cut-off date of 01 July 2026, based on the date of birth in the High School marksheet/certificate.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to apply for Bareilly Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application must be submitted by 29 September 2026.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply online for Bareilly Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through upanganwadibharti.in by filling the form correctly and uploading self-attested copies of the required documents, before 29 September 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Bareilly Anganwadi Sahayika Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no written exam or interview. Selection follows a fixed priority order based on widow/divorced/abandoned status and below/above poverty line status among resident candidates of the concerned ward/Gram Sabha.
